title: Think Bigger
description: Innovative solutions to complex problems that are both novel and useful. Focuses on The Think Bigger Innovation Method, uses decision-making theory, cognitive science, and industry practice to facilitate creativity and innovation. Designed to foster new ideas during the beginning of the semester that will then function as the seeds for entrepreneurially minded. Culminates in a final project with presentation of formal and polished pitch of an innovative idea in front of a distinguished panel of successful minds from across the city
